ModMetaData.name: Skylights
ModMetaData.author: archdukejim
ModMetaData.description:
Bring real daylight into a roofed room. Powerless and cool, skylights light a room by the actual sky above — bright at midday, fading through dusk, dark at night, and dimmed by storms and eclipses. They never make a spot brighter than the day outside. Unlocked with Electricity, alongside the electric smelter.
--- DOME SKYLIGHT --- A small dome that spreads soft daylight across a radius of about two tiles. It lights a room by natural light but never concentrates enough sun to grow crops — ideal for workshops, bedrooms and walkways. Drops in almost instantly from a prefabricated skylight dome. Blocked by thick overhead mountain, which seals off the sky.
--- PANED SKYLIGHT --- A glazed pane that opens the roof to the sky: the tile below is lit exactly as if there were no roof at all — sun and shadows by day, moonlight by night — while staying sealed against rain, snow and cold. Bright enough to grow crops by daylight. Drag out a whole glass roof like laying floors; each pane takes four structural frames and a structural glass pane.
--- MOUNTAIN DOME SKYLIGHT --- A dome fitted to a reflection tube that pipes daylight down through solid rock, so it keeps working even beneath thick overhead mountain. Spreads the same soft light as the dome; built from a skylight dome and a reflection tube.
--- THE SUPPLY CHAIN --- Everything is fabricated at an electric smelter: Skylight dome — two steel. Reflection tube — five steel. Structural frame — one steel makes four (single or bulk batch). Structural glass — one steel makes one pane (single or bulk batch). Structural frames and glass are inert and never rot, even left outdoors.
--- NOTES --- Skylights sit up in the roof — they can't be clicked, and are removed with the Architect > Orders > Deconstruct tool. An honest trade against a sun lamp: free and never overheats a room, but only as bright as the day outside and dark every night.
Requires Harmony. Safe to add or remove mid-save.
